name: Parousia

phase_0.boundary_condition: The Omega Point of divine-human convergence

VINIT.justification: The unmanifest state before the Word initiates the return cycle.

TANCH.justification: The final closed boundary containing the perfected system of the New Creation.

AFWD.justification: The forward transformation of the material into the divine state.

AREV.justification: The descent of the divine into the material constraints of history.

CLINK.justification: The sequential chaining of historical events into a single salvific narrative.

IMSCRIB.justification: The identity of the Logos recognizing itself across the temporal span.

FSPLIT.justification: The separation of the totality of history into distinct paths of evaluation.

FFUSE.justification: The reconstitution of all things into the singular body of the Logos.

EVALT.justification: The affirmative branch of eternal life and communion.

EVALF.justification: The negative branch of separation and non-being.

ENGAGR.justification: The simultaneous holding of divine will and human suffering without resolution.

IFIX.justification: The permanent and irreversible record of every soul and action.

phase_3.void_description: The state before the first fiat lux
phase_3.true_description: Eternal participation in the divine nature
phase_3.false_description: The state of self-imposed isolation from the source
phase_3.both_description: The intersection of the temporal and the eternal in the person of Christ

steps.domain_action: The silence before the manifestation of the Logos
The Logos recognizes its own eternal nature
The divine descends into the historical process through incarnation
The historical life and ministry chain together as a single morphism
The tension of the cross holds death and life in simultaneous suspension
The resurrection initiates the forward movement toward glory
The ascension fixes the human nature into the divine throne permanently
The Last Judgment divides the sum of history into two distinct paths
The affirmative path leads to the beatific vision
The negative path leads to the void of separation
Recapitulation gathers all fragments of history back into the Logos
The New Creation seals the system in eternal completion

phase_5.compiler_frontend: The Holy Spirit translating divine intent into historical providence
phase_5.ipc_mechanism: Prayer and grace facilitating communication between the human and divine
phase_5.memory_mechanism: The collective consciousness of the communion of saints
phase_5.scheduler_mechanism: The Kairos determining the fullness of time for the return
phase_5.alfs_store: The eternal decree of the Godhead

phase_6.cycle_cost: The kenotic emptying of the divine into time
phase_6.pre_cycle_state: A fragmented and entropic temporal order
phase_6.post_cycle_state: A perfected and negentropic eternal order
phase_6.delta_s_verdict: ΔS ≈ 0 — The energy lost in the fall is fully recovered in the recapitulation
